# ReshmaTex — AI Workforce Upskilling Platform
> Role-specific AI training, interactive roleplay simulations, and enterprise knowledge grounding for Sales, HR, and Finance teams.

## Core Documentation
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Full technical architecture, canonical data models, and modification rules for autonomous agents and LLMs.
- [README.md](README.md): Human-facing overview, feature breakdown, getting started guide, and enterprise security standards.

## Project Characteristics
- Framework: React 19 SPA + TypeScript + Vite 8
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite) + Inter / Plus Jakarta Sans fonts
- Icons: Lucide React (lucide-react)
- Animations & Confetti: canvas-confetti
- Persistence: LocalStorage synchronized under `reshmatex_app_v2_*` keys
- Port: 3000

## Key Code Locations
- State Orchestration: `src/App.tsx`
- Type Contracts: `src/types.ts`
- Curricula & Mock Data: `src/data/mockData.ts`
- Landing & Public Pages: `src/components/LandingPage.tsx`, `src/components/Navbar.tsx`
- Department Tracks: `src/views/TrackView.tsx`
- AI Roleplay Sandbox: `src/views/PlaygroundView.tsx`
- Enterprise RAG Knowledge: `src/views/KnowledgeView.tsx`
- Analytics & Reports: `src/views/AnalyticsView.tsx`
- Team Management: `src/views/TeamView.tsx`

## Verification Commands
- Lint / Type Check: `npm run lint` (runs `tsc --noEmit`)
- Production Build: `npm run build` (runs `vite build`)
